# DeepSeek Harness Phase 2D fixtures

These format-v0 JSONL fixtures are minimal, sanitized, and byte-protected. They never contain copied real prompts or payloads.

- `permission`: the initial `workspace-write／workspace-write／ask` ordering is structurally derived from all six copied real Sessions. Partial snapshots arise naturally after the first two rows. The custom preset name and later independent knob switches are current-source-backed synthetic evidence for configurable preset tables and latest-wins folds; they were not observed in the copied corpus.
- `inbox`: one human `next-turn` enqueue／claim and one plugin `next-step` enqueue／claim are sanitized structural derivations of the copied corpus. Message text is synthetic; exact MessageId／role／source／content equality preserves the durable writer relationship without copying real payloads.

这些 format-v0 JSONL fixture 最小化、脱敏并受字节保护，绝不包含复制的真实 prompt 或 payload。`permission` 的初始顺序来自六份复制真实 Session；custom preset 与后续独立 knob switch 仅由当前源码支撑，并非复制语料实证。`inbox` 的人类 next-turn 与 plugin next-step enqueue／claim 来自真实结构，消息内容完全合成。
